description: Turn an analysed drawing into the quality control plan the documents will print: one row per characteristic with its balloon number (numeric, padded or type-prefixed; printed drawing numbers kept by default), acceptance limits computed from nominal ± tolerance (dimensional tolerances only — fits, threads, GD&T and surface finishes are judged with gauges), the default measuring instrument per type, the inspection class/rate, and the section order. Deterministic and offline: adjust the plan options and call again until the plan is right, then pass the same options to the export tools.

plan.description: Plan settings — shared by build_quality_plan and both export tools; pass the same object to every call so the documents match the reviewed plan. Everything is optional; defaults reproduce the web app's initial plan.

annotation.description: stamp an "INSPECTION DRAWING" annotation block (article/drawing no., revision, date, note) on the main drawing page

x.description: top-left x in analysis image pixels (default: top-left corner area)

article_name.description: article name printed in the plan header

default_tools.description: default measuring instrument per characteristic type, e.g. {"dimensional": "Caliper", "geometric": "CMM"}; overrides the built-in defaults (geometric CMM, thread/fineThread thread plug gauge, dimensional caliper, drill inside micrometer, shaft outside micrometer, length depth caliper, surface roughness gauge)

drawing.description: title-block values to print instead of what the analysis read (article/drawing number, material, general tolerance)

drawing_index.description: drawing revision/index printed in the plan header

exclude.description: feature ids to drop from the selection

header.description: plan header fields; explicit values win over the inspection_class preset

include.description: explicit feature ids to select — replaces the preset

include_checklist.description: print the visual-inspection checklist in the Excel report (default from the inspection class; on for 100 %/Q1, off for Q2)

inspection_class.description: "100%" (full inspection, rate 100 %, checklist on), "Q1" (reduced, 10 %, checklist on), "Q2" (spot check, 5 %, checklist off) apply the preset rate + checklist; any other text is used verbatim as the class name

order.description: custom (default): balloon numbers printed on the drawing are kept, the rest fill up in table order; list: plan-table order; reading: position on the drawing (top-left → bottom-right, page by page); measurement: geometric tolerances (CMM) first, surface finishes last

restart_per_type.description: restart the counter for every characteristic type (always on for typePrefixed)

style.description: numeric "1, 2, 3" (default); padded "001"; typePrefixed "D001/H001/S001/T001/F001/G001/R001/L001" (D dimensional, H drill fit, S shaft fit, T thread, F fine thread, G geometric, R surface roughness, L length)

balloon.description: manual balloon number for this row (duplicates are reported)

inspection_tool.description: instrument for this row (wins over the type default)

samples.description: measured actual value; judged against the acceptance limits unless passed is given

value.description: corrected characteristic value, e.g. "⌀50 ±0.05", "12 +0.2 -0.1", "10 H7"; the original is kept as a change-tracking footnote

section_order.description: order of the plan sections; listed types first, the rest in the default measurement sequence (geometric, thread, fineThread, dimensional, drill, shaft, length, surface)

selection.description: which characteristics the plan contains: all (default; first-article inspection), production (measurable only: dimensional, drill, shaft, length, geometric — no threads or surface finishes), none (then list them in include)

show_arrows.description: VDA-style leader arrows from balloons to their characteristics on the drawing pages (default true)

name: build_quality_plan
title: Build the quality control plan
